question: Which programme of the Ministry of Power successfully completed seven years of distributing and selling LED lights on January 2022?
solution:
The answer is __**UJALA.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Unnat Jyoti by Affordable LED'S for All (UJALA) **was launched by the Prime Minister of India** Shri Narendra Modi in 2015.**
 
• The program is the **world's largest zero-subsidy domestic lighting program.**
 
• The objective of the program aimed at reducing the cost of LED bulbs and **shifting a change from earlier used fluorescent bulbs to LED bulbs.**
 
• Under the program, the cost of** LED bulbs was brought down to 80-100 from 300-400.** The program has proven itself to be environmentally viable by **reduction of approximately 386 crore tonnes of CO₂.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ujjwala Yojana** was launched by Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi on 1 May 2016 **aiming to distribute 50 Million LPG connections.**
 
• **Bijli Yojana** is Known as Saubhagya yojana which ensures the **provision of electricity to all households.**
 
• **Prakash Yojana** also referred to as Jeevan Prakash yojana is started by the government of Maharashtra **aiming to provide electricity connection to households of Sc and ST. **
